COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days > 21.0 AND touch.age_days <= 120.0 THEN touch.weight ELSE 0.0 END), 0.0) AS prior_weight, DATE_FORMAT(MAX(touch.touched_at), '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS last_touch_at, SUM(CASE WHEN touch.age_days <= 21.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_touch_count FROM company c LEFT JOIN ( SELECT attributed.company_id, attributed.touched_at, attributed.weight, GREATEST(0.0, TIMESTAMPDIFF(MICROSECOND, attributed.touched_at, #{reference}) / 86400000000.0) AS age_days FROM ( SELECT source.touch_kind, source.touch_id, source.company_id, source.touched_at, source.weight FROM ( SELECT 'activity' AS touch_kind, a.id AS touch_id, p.company_id, a.timestamp AS touched_at, CASE LOWER(a.type) WHEN 'meeting' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'call' THEN 0.8 WHEN 'email' THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.5 END AS weight FROM activity a JOIN person p ON p.id = a.person_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.company_id IS NOT NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND UNION ALL SELECT 'activity' AS touch_kind, a.id AS touch_id, d.company_id, a.timestamp AS touched_at, CASE LOWER(a.type) WHEN 'meeting' THEN 1.0 WHEN 'call' THEN 0.8 WHEN 'email' THEN 0.6 ELSE 0.5 END AS weight FROM activity a JOIN deal d ON d.id = a.deal_id WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id IS NOT NULL AND (a.person_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.id = a.person_id AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND )) UNION ALL SELECT 'note' AS touch_kind, n.id AS touch_id, p.company_id, n.created_at AS touched_at, 0.4 AS weight FROM note n JOIN person p ON p.id = n.person_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND p.company_id IS NOT NULL AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND UNION ALL SELECT 'note' AS touch_kind, n.id AS touch_id, d.company_id, n.created_at AS touched_at, 0.4 AS weight FROM note n JOIN deal d ON d.id = n.deal_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id IS NOT NULL AND (n.person_id IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.id = n.person_id AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND )) UNION ALL SELECT 'task' AS AND p.suspended_at IS NULL AND UNION ALL SELECT 'task' AS touch_kind, t.id AS touch_id, d.company_id, t.created_at AS touched_at, 0.3 AS weight FROM task t JOIN deal d ON d.id = t.deal_id WHERE SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) AS person_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id = #{companyId}) AS num_deals, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_activities, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.completed = FALSE AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS open_tasks, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId}))) AS num_notes

SELECT related.user_id, COUNT(*) OVER() AS total_users FROM ( SELECT touch.user_id, MAX(touch.touched_at) AS last_touched_at FROM ( SELECT a.created_by_id AS user_id, a.timestamp AS touched_at FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT t.assigned_to_id AS user_id, t.created_at AS touched_at FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT n.author_id AS user_id, n.created_at AS touched_at FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) ) touch WHERE touch.user_id IS NOT NULL GROUP BY touch.user_id ) related ORDER BY related.last_touched_at DESC, related.user_id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FLOOR(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, #{windowStart}, touch.touched_at) / 604800) AS bucket_index, SUM(touch.kind = 'activities') AS activities, SUM(touch.kind = 'tasks') AS tasks, SUM(touch.kind = 'notes') AS notes FROM ( SELECT 'activities' AS kind, a.timestamp AS touched_at FROM activity a WHERE a.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND a.timestamp >= #{windowStart} AND a.timestamp <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = a.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = a.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT 'tasks' AS kind, t.created_at AS touched_at FROM task t WHERE t.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND t.created_at >= #{windowStart} AND t.created_at <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = t.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = t.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) UNION ALL SELECT 'notes' AS kind, n.created_at AS touched_at FROM note n WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.visibility = 'workspace' AND n.created_at >= #{windowStart} AND n.created_at <= #{windowEnd} AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM person p WHERE p.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND p.id = n.person_id AND p.company_id = #{companyId}) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.id = n.deal_id AND d.company_id = #{companyId})) ) touch GROUP BY bucket_index ORDER BY bucket_index

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(d.currency, ''), 'USD') AS currency, COUNT(*) AS deal_count, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won = TRUE THEN d.actual_value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS past_revenue, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN d.won IS NULL THEN d.value ELSE 0 END), 0) AS projected_revenue FROM deal d WHERE d.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND d.company_id = #{companyId} GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(d.currency, ''), 'USD') ORDER BY deal_count DESC, currency
